title: Compression work from two volumes
statement:
A gas changes volume from $[$v]$ L to 1.25 L against 1.60 atm. Find the pressure–volume work in joules. Use 101.325 J per L·atm.

[________]{a}

feedback.message: Compression gives positive work for the system.

hints: Apply the minus sign in the work equation.
Compression gives positive work for the system.
solution: $w=-P_\mathrm{ext}(V_f-V_i)=-1.60(1.25-[$v])(101.325)$ J. Compression makes the result positive.
